subject: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — contract extension & capacity details
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medvox.com>, Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@medvox.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — contract extension & capacity details

Hi Sana / Oliver —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. As discussed, MedVox is planning to consolidate EU traffic into a dedicated EU tenancy and run an APAC seeding pilot for Q1. I attached the first-pass SOW (SOW_EU_Carveout_v1.pdf) and a short summary below.

Key asks from your side:
- EU carve-out: dedicated EU tenancy with data residency for EU tenant, audit log retention 5 years (SOC2 alignment).
- APAC seeding: warm-standby nodes in APAC region for low-latency burst traffic; initial capacity to cover 20% of peak EU qps for first 90 days.
- Contract: extend current term by 12 months with a capacity uplift and a carve-out addendum to the DPA.

Decision points we need from MedVox to finalize pricing/contract:
1) Confirm baseline qps and expected 90-day APAC burst percentage (we used 20% in the draft).
2) Any additional compliance controls (encryption/HSM key requirements) beyond our standard EU package.
3) Preferred sign-off owners and timeline — legal + procurement or do you want Redwood to lead with a redline?

Proposed next steps:
- You review SOW_EU_Carveout_v1 and send questions by EOD Friday.
- We incorporate changes and return SOW_EU_Carveout_v2 + pricing sheet.
- Quick contract review call next week to lock dates and DocuSign routing.

If useful, we can scope a canary cutover runbook for the EU tenancy and a short APAC failover checklist — I put a link to a sample runbook in the related links.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: SOW_EU_Carveout_v1.pdf
From: Sana Patel <sana.patel@medvox.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@medvox.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — contract extension & capacity details

Dylan —

Thanks for the summary and the SOW. Quick answers from our side:
- Baseline: EU production peak avg ~1,800 qps during weekday peaks. We expect seasonal peaks up to ~2,400 qps.
- APAC pilot: 20% of peak sounds reasonable to start, but we may want to flex to 35% for scheduled marketing spikes.
- Compliance: We need HSM-backed keys for EU tenant and an audit trail export format consistent with our internal tooling (JSONL preferred).

On procurement: legal + procurement will own the final sign-off. We prefer that Redwood send a redline-ready amendment to speed review.

Can we schedule a 30-min contract clarification call next Tuesday (Nov 16) 10:00 CET? Oliver will join as well.

Regards,
Sana Patel
VP Product & Data, MedVox Health
sana.patel@medvox.com | +44 20 7946 0881
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0500
Subject: FW: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — ask from MedVox (capacity & HSM)

Team — forwarding Sana's note. Action items:
- Ben: draft the contract amendment language (12 month extension + capacity uplift tiers and overage rates) and include DPA carve-out for EU tenancy with HSM requirement.
- Marissa: from a delivery standpoint, can we guarantee HSM-backed key management in EU tenancy? Any lead time/extra cost?
- Lauren: update CS runbook for an APAC warm-standby workflow that supports 20% base and ability to spike to 35% for scheduled events; attach a rough Excel with node counts.

We should aim to have SOW_EU_Carveout_v2 + pricing back to Sana by Monday EOD so legal can start redlining.

Thanks — Dylan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — ask from MedVox (capacity & HSM)

Dylan / team —

Attached are two files: SOW_EU_Carveout_v2.pdf (redlines and the new DPA addendum language) and apac-seeding-runbook.xlsx (estimated node counts and a 90-day ramp). Summary here:
- Pricing: 12-month extension with a 22% uplift on baseline hosted rates to account for EU tenancy isolation + HSM. Includes one week of dedicated migration support.
- APAC seeding: base config sized to 20% of peak (~360 qps), with automated burst policy to 35% (~630 qps) using warm nodes and auto-burst credits.
- HSM: We support customer-managed HSM via KMS integration in EU tenancy. Implementation lead time: ~3 weeks from PO. There is a one-time onboarding fee for HSM provisioning (listed in the SOW).

I'll mark the SOW and highlight the clauses legal will want to see. If that aligns, we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and the amendment for MedVox legal.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_EU_Carveout_v2.pdf, apac-seeding-runbook.xlsx
From: Oliver Nguyen <oliver.nguyen@medvox.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sana Patel <sana.patel@medvox.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EU data carve-out + APAC seeding — contract extension & capacity details

Dylan / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated SOW. This looks good overall and addresses our questions. A couple small asks before legal moves forward:
- Please include a clause specifying the audit log export frequency (weekly) and format (JSONL).
- Add a 30-day SLA for key-provisioning timeline in the HSM onboarding section (we'd like a committed target).

We're happy to take your redline on the amendment next week. Sana and I confirmed the call for Tue Nov 23, 10:00 CET for a short contract review. Please add DocuSign routing for both legal and procurement on your end.

Oliver
Director, Infrastructure — MedVox Health
oliver.nguyen@medvox.com | +1 212-555-0123
